value.answer: Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot, designed for agentic coding and complex multi-step workflows. It is available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise SKUs and can be selected in Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot app, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse. Rollout will be gradual.
